It **must be a multimodal model that accepts image input** — whiteboard, canvas and chat image questions go to it first (a model that cannot read images falls back to the vision model automatically). The dropdown holds the approved few; any other model name can be typed in. Verify with the model self-test after changing.

field_CHAT_MEMORY_ENABLED_desc: When APPID is empty, the platform keeps the last few turns so follow-ups can refer back
field_CHAT_MEMORY_MAX_TURNS_desc: How many recent Q&A pairs (1 turn = one question + one answer) are sent to the model. Higher = more coherent, more tokens
field_CHAT_MEMORY_TTL_MINUTES_desc: Inactive conversations are cleared after this period
field_CHAT_MEMORY_MAX_CHARS_desc: Oldest turns are dropped once the history exceeds this many characters; the latest pair is always kept
field_CHAT_MEMORY_CONTENT_MAX_CHARS_desc: Affects memory only, not the conversation view or history
field_CHAT_MEMORY_MAX_ROWS_desc: Oldest rows are evicted beyond this limit to prevent runaway growth
field_CHAT_MEMORY_PRUNE_INTERVAL_MINUTES: Background sweep interval that reclaims dead sessions the user never returns to
field_AI_GRADING_INTERVAL_SEC_desc: How often the background grader looks for pending subjective answers. Smaller = faster scores, larger = fewer AI calls. Takes effect on the next cycle after saving
field_AI_GRADING_BATCH_SIZE_desc: How many answers to the same question are graded in one AI call. Larger saves tokens but makes each response longer and more timeout-prone
field_AI_GRADING_CONCURRENCY_desc: Number of grading calls running at once. Too high competes with chat/question generation; 1-3 is usual
field_AI_GRADING_MAX_ITEMS_PER_ROUND_des: Maximum questions per sweep; the rest wait for the next round
field_MAX_DOC_SIZE_MB_desc: Per-file limit for document/courseware uploads, enforced on both sides.
field_JWT_EXPIRATION_HOURS_desc: Applies to new logins only; existing sessions keep their token until it expires
field_ONLINE_USER_TIMEOUT_SECONDS_desc: A user counts as offline after this long without any request; drives the online-user list.
field_ENABLE_REQUEST_LIMIT_desc: Counts requests per user per day and rejects over the limit
field_MAX_ALLOWED_REQUESTS_desc: Per-user daily cap, counted on chat entries only
field_JWT_RENEW_THRESHOLD_MINUTES_desc: Renew when less than this remains; 0 = half the lifetime (max 6 hours)
field_ENABLE_IP_GUARD_desc: Temporarily ban sources with repeated failures; counters live in memory and reset on restart

field_AUTH_FAIL_BAN_SECONDS_desc: How long to reject every endpoint (including public ones) from that source; 0 = log only, no ban

field_REWARD_DAILY_ACADEMIC_POINTS_desc: Max points per student per day from graded work: exams, in-class quizzes, synced/course practice, tasks, code practice, quest. Its own pool — it is not crowded out by chat or buzzer rounds.

guide.studentTitle: How do I hand in this homework?
guide.studentIntro: There are two kinds of homework: if the teacher asks for a chat transcript, talk it through in Knowledge Q&A and submit; if they ask for files, upload Word/PDF/sheets/slides or a photo of your work.
studentSteps: Check the submission type tag and the requirements first - do you hand in a chat transcript or files, and when is the deadline.
Chat transcript: in Knowledge Q&A ask the AI questions, discuss, let it check your reasoning until the conversation is complete.
Files: click the submit button and drag or pick files (on a phone you can take a photo). The dialog header shows how many files, the size cap and how many attempts you have left.
You can resubmit before the deadline - only the last attempt is graded. Late submissions are usually still accepted but tagged as late.
After submitting, click a file name to download what you handed in. Until the teacher publishes, the row shows "Grading".
Once published, open Score to see the total, per-dimension scores, the requirement checklist, comments and next steps.
To redo it: ask your teacher to revert your submission in Details, then complete it again and resubmit.
guide.teacherTitle: How do I assign and grade?
guide.teacherIntro: Assignments come in two types: chat transcripts (students work it out with the AI and hand in the conversation) and files (Word/PDF/sheets/slides/images). In both cases the AI grades first and you publish after review.
teacherSteps: When creating homework, pick the submission type first: chat transcript / files / files + note. The requirements are the AI rubric - write checkable items ("includes data sources", not "work carefully").
Not sure how to word it? Use "Draft with AI": choose the type, describe your idea, and the AI returns the title and requirements - for file homework also scoring dimensions and suggested file types.

File homework lets you set: deadline, allowed types and count (default 3 files, 10MB each), submission attempts (default 3), full score and dimensions. Late uploads are still accepted and only tagged.
After students submit, the Submitted column shows the headcount and how many still need grading; file homework is tagged in the name column and the list has a Deadline column.

Click the eye icon: for chat homework read each transcript; for file homework the grading board shows every file, its extracted text or image preview, plus similarity check and a zip download of the whole class.

Grade with AI: the robot icon grades the whole chat class at once; for file homework use "Grade whole class" (runs in background - images are read by a vision model first, progress visible) or "Re-grade this student".
Results include per-dimension scores, a per-requirement checklist (met / partial / missing) and quotes from the work. If a judgement is off, use "Review / edit" - the original AI score is kept.
Students only see scores after you "Publish grades" (they get a notification and grade-level bonus points). Use revert to let a student redo, and the check icon to close the homework.

field_CLASS_LADDER_SOUND_ENABLED_desc: Master switch for big-screen sound (start / tick / correct / wrong / lifeline / settle). Sounds are synthesised in-browser via Web Audio — no assets, no network, no cost. Turning it off greys out the page-level switch.

field_MULTIPLE_CHOICE_SCORING_desc: Scoring for partial (missing) and wrong selections. Strict: no points for partial/wrong; Partial: 50% of full score for partial, 0 for wrong. Applies to exams/practice/quizzes, proportional to each question's full score
field_SHOWCASE_RANK_MODE_desc: Controls who sees ranks on cards, so low ranks are not exposed
field_CLASS_DRILL_AI_ENABLED: Allow AI questions in class drill
field_CLASS_DRILL_AI_ENABLED_desc: When off, questions come from the bank only — zero AI cost

field_PORTRAIT_EXTRA_POINTS_desc: The first generation each period is free; later ones cost this many points, refunded automatically when no image was produced.
field_PORTRAIT_EXTRA_MAX_desc: Excludes the free one. Stops repeated generation from burning the AI budget.
field_PORTRAIT_STAFF_MAX_desc: Teachers and admins are outside the points system (free), so a per-period cap is required — otherwise it is an open image-generation endpoint.

field_PODCAST_VOICE_B_desc: The guest who asks and follows up. Leave empty to auto-pick for the current model (defaults to a female voice). Both voices must belong to the speech model above, or saving is refused.
field_PODCAST_DURATION_OPTIONS_desc: Duration choices offered in the podcast dialog: pick presets or type custom minutes (1-30). Duplicates are removed and the list is sorted on save; empty falls back to 3, 4, 5.
field_PODCAST_MAX_SECONDS_desc: Scripts longer than this are truncated so no oversized page is produced (60-1800 seconds, default 300). Keep it at least the largest option × 60.
field_CAST_DURATION_OPTIONS_desc: Duration choices for lesson casts, independent from podcast. Pick or type minutes (1-30); takes effect immediately.
field_CAST_DEFAULT_MINUTES_desc: Default option when opening the AI lesson cast dialog; must be one of the options above

field_TTS_VOICE_desc: Only voices verified to produce audio are listed; search by Chinese name or style
placeholder_ttsVoice: Pick a voice, search by name or style
modelNotVisibleTag: not found in the account model list — shown only, never blocked
placeholder_modelSelect: Pick from the list, or type a model name
imageSizeAutoLabel: auto — send no size, use the model default
imageSizeAutoSwitch: Size {{size}} does not apply to the new model; switched to auto
ttsVoiceAutoSwitch: Switched to this model's default voice: {{voice}}
selfTestCostHint: The self-test makes one real call and incurs a small fee
imageTestHint: Generates one minimal image with the current model, endpoint and size to verify the settings
ttsTestHint: Synthesises a fixed sentence and returns playable audio, confirming the model/voice pair and the key
ttsTestMismatch: The saved voice is {{configured}} but a different one was used (voice/model mismatch, fell back automatically) — please pick a voice again
field_KB_REL_GAP_desc: Drop chunks scoring below top score × this factor (0 = off)
field_CHAT_META_GUARD_ENABLED_desc: These no longer hit the knowledge base, so a greeting is not turned into a lecture
field_CHAT_IDENTITY_GUARD_ENABLED_desc: Inject a system identity (“you are this platform’s AI teacher / study companion”) that forbids self-reporting the underlying model name, and move retrieved material into the system prompt so the user’s question stands alone.
field_CHAT_SKILL_SEGMENT_MODE_desc: Keep “inside system prompt” in most cases
field_CHAT_META_MAX_TOKENS_desc: Output cap for identity/greeting answers (100-4000 tokens, default 600) so a one-line question never becomes a 1000-word lesson.
hwModeLockedHint: Students already submitted; submission type is locked
hwDeadlineNote: Late uploads are only tagged, never auto-deducted; decide that in the rubric or when editing scores
hwPolicyReview: AI grades first, teacher publishes after review (recommended)
hwDimSum: Dimensions total {{sum}} / full score {{total}} (rescaled automatically if mismatched)
hwClosedWarn: Deadline passed — this upload will be marked late
hwNoteHint: e.g. design ideas, data sources, division of work
hwUploadHint: Word (.docx), PDF, Excel, PPT, text and images; images are read by a vision model
hwNoText: No extracted text (scanned or unparsable) — download the original
hwJobTimeout: Grading is still running in background — refresh later instead of resubmitting
hwSimFound: {{n}} similar pairs flagged in the grading board
hwSimWarn: Similar submissions (flag only — the teacher decides)
field_HOMEWORK_MAX_FILE_MB_desc: Per-file limit for homework uploads and the ceiling teachers can set
field_HOMEWORK_MAX_FILES_desc: Default number of files allowed per submission (teachers may lower it per homework).
field_HOMEWORK_ALLOWED_EXTS_desc: File types students may submit: pick a suggestion or type and press Enter
field_HOMEWORK_ENABLE_VL_desc: For image homework (handwritten photos, artwork, screenshots) a vision model transcribes and describes the file before grading. If off, images can still be submitted but grading falls back to manual. Independent of the chat multimodal toggle.
hwNoTimesLeftHint: Ask your teacher to revert your submission in the assignment details to submit again.
hwPickFirstAgain: No new file selected: pick the file(s) to re-submit above (already uploaded files need not be re-added)
skillNoneEnabledDesc: AI features still work, but fall back to the base model's default style: less structure, fewer examples, weaker follow-up guidance and no content-safety layer. Use "Enable all" at the top right to restore it.
skillRecommendedTip: Carries a baseline guardrail (e.g. content safety). Turning it off won't break the feature but removes that constraint
taskMobileReadonlyHint: Mobile is view-only: edit, AI grading, ending and deleting tasks need the desktop app.
field_wrong_practice_threshold_desc: Once a student's pending mistakes exceed this number, a practice set is pushed automatically; 0 means push whenever any mistake exists.
field_wrong_practice_per_set_desc: How many questions each auto set contains (1-20). Selection prefers frequently-missed and long-neglected questions, avoiding recent sets.
field_wrong_practice_interval_days_desc: Minimum days between two auto sets. It also decides how long an unanswered set keeps blocking new pushes; stale sets are then closed automatically.
field_wrong_practice_avoid_recent_sets_d: Exclude questions served in the last N sets (0 = no exclusion). Falls back to the full pool when too few candidates remain.
field_wrong_book_sources_desc: Which activities feed the mistake book. Exams are always on and cannot be turned off; practice, quick quiz, class questioning, course practice and class ladder can each be toggled (only activities whose questions map back to the bank are offered). Changes apply on save and never rewrite existing rows.
wbsTodoTip: No ingestion path for this activity yet — ticking it has no effect until it is wired up
loginGateDesc: For maintenance windows: turn off login for specific roles or external traffic. Administrators are unaffected; signed-in users are sent back to the login page on their next request.
reloadConfirmContent: {{n}} unsaved changes will be lost after reloading.
zone_school_desc: Branding, subjects, notification types and the honour wall. Set once at deployment.
zone_teaching_desc: Points, quests, mistake practice, student portraits and classroom tools. Tuned day to day.
zone_storage_desc: Upload and download limits, sessions, access protection and version sync.
optBankModeAi: Generated by AI on the fly
field_AGENT_EDITION_tip: For example “Math Edition” or “Biology Edition”. Display only.
field_SHOWCASE_AUTO_ENABLED_tip: Opening the page also tops up missing cards; a background sweep catches students whose points just became positive. Cards removed by a teacher are never revived.
field_APPID_tip: Create it at Bailian → Application Center → My applications → Create agent app → copy the APPID. The APPID must belong to the same Alibaba Cloud account as DASHSCOPE_API_KEY.
field_KB_API_BASE_tip: Enter the bare domain (e.g. https://llm-xxx.cn-beijing.maas.aliyuncs.com); /compatible-mode/v1 is appended automatically. Chat and knowledge retrieval prefer it. It must belong to the same workspace as the API key, otherwise retrieval fails with Agent application not found.
field_QWEN_OPENAI_API_BASE_tip: Used directly when the dedicated domain is empty. Pick one of the two official endpoints or enter a full URL with path (normalised to /compatible-mode/v1); self-hosted gateways and proxies take their real address.
field_KB_ENABLED_tip: Every business that used the APPID agent (questions, lesson plans, grading, analytics, whiteboard) switches to direct + Bailian knowledge retrieval. In chat, the “Knowledge” toggle still controls retrieval per message (off by default). Disabling or incomplete config restores the previous behaviour.
field_CHAT_MEMORY_ENABLED_tip: Adds a small amount of input tokens. Disabled behaves exactly like no memory.
field_IMAGE_GEN_MODEL_tip: Default is wan2.2-t2i-flash. Tested models use their measured endpoint and size rules; untested ones fall back to the conservative 512–1440 range. Models not listed can be typed in.
field_PORTRAIT_AUTO_PUSH_tip: At each new period, one portrait is generated for active students and pushed, costing one LLM call and one image call each. Off by default; for large schools switch the period to monthly first.
field_CLASS_LADDER_DEFAULT_SKIN_tip: Light: cloud, sunrise, mint. Dark: star, cyber, academy, classic.
field_HOMEWORK_MAX_FILE_MB_tip: When deploying behind IIS, remember to raise the request filtering limit as well.
field_HOMEWORK_ALLOWED_EXTS_tip: Legacy .doc/.ppt/.xls cannot be parsed safely and are rejected by default; ask users to save as .docx/.pptx/.xlsx.
field_TRUST_PROXY_HEADERS_tip: Keep it off when directly exposed to the internet, otherwise clients can spoof their source IP and bypass bans.
field_ENABLE_IP_GUARD_tip: Off by default: behind Hsk/NAT traversal all remote visitors share the relay IP, so IP bans can hit everyone. Turning it off only affects banning; failed IP+UA+referer are still logged.
field_ENABLE_REQUEST_LIMIT_tip: Counts AI chat (Q&A, knowledge, companion) and the whiteboard assistant; administrators are exempt. Off by default.
field_auto_pull_enabled_tip: Syncs are written to upgrade history. Database migrations or dependency changes are never auto-synced; upgrade manually instead.
field_UPGRADE_AUTO_BACKUP_tip: When on, every upgrade creates a pre-upgrade backup (config + both databases) under Backup & restore, which adds up over time. When off, the upgrade still keeps a config guard snapshot so the config cannot be reset to defaults; take a manual backup before upgrading if you need one.
field_TTS_VOICE_tip: Voices are not interchangeable between the two models. Defaults: News anchor (male) for 3.0, Long Sanshu (male) for 3.1.
boundTaskReadonly: Read-only preview: created by another teacher, bound to a course knowledge point
configRestoreAlertTitle: Fewer subjects or empty keys? Recover them here
configRestoreAlertDesc: An upgrade or a mistake can reset the whole config to factory defaults. All local copies are listed and sorted by a health score: higher scores marked "Usable" are closer to your real config; red ones are almost certainly factory defaults and will not help. The current file is backed up before restoring.
configRestoreConfirmTitle: Overwrite the current config with this copy?
configRestoreConfirmDesc: The current file will be saved as system_config.json.before-restore.<time> first, so you can switch back.
configRestoreLoadFailed: Failed to load the backup list
backupDataAlertTitle: Take a full backup before upgrading or major changes
backupDataDesc: Default backup: both databases + system config + node id; Git deployments also ship a source snapshot. Tick full-site backup to also copy content dirs (root / stu / question_media / temp_uploads / ChatHistory). Use Restore to roll the whole box back, or the config panel below for a config-only rollback.
backupEmpty: No backups yet — click "Back up now" to create the first one
backupRestoreConfirmTitle: Overwrite current databases and config with this backup?
backupRestoreConfirmDesc: Data created after this backup (answers, points, homework, uploads…) will be lost. The current state is saved automatically first and can be found in this list.
backupDeleteConfirm: Delete this backup? Files are removed from disk and cannot be recovered.
configRestoreDeleteConfirm: Delete this config backup? The file is removed from disk.
storageHealthFactory: System config looks reset to factory defaults
storageHealthHint: Only one subject left, empty APPID/knowledge base breaks the whole app. Restore a healthy copy below instead of saving over this state.
storageLegacyRisk: Another database still lives in the code directory
storageLegacyRiskDesc: A desktop overwrite-install wipes the app directory first. Tick full-site backup before upgrading, or confirm data was merged into the user data dir above.
storageAlertSent: Admins notified about the config issue
storageAlertNone: Config is healthy, or this same state was already reported
backupDataDescFull: Full-site backup: databases + system config + content dirs. The first full backup is slower; later restores only add missing files.
backupRestoreConfirmNoContent: This backup has no content dirs: databases and config roll back, files added after it stay. Current data is saved first.
backupDeleteLastHint: This is the only remaining backup; deleting it leaves nothing to roll back to.
mergedAlertTitle: Two scopes - pick the right one
mergedAlertDesc: Full = databases + system config (plus content dirs for full-site backups); it rolls back answers, points and homework created after that backup. Config = overwrites system_config.json only, for lost subjects/keys without touching databases. Either way current data is saved first.
storageSelfhealHint: row dumps kept before dirty-data cleanup, safe to purge manually (not a backup entry)
field_AI_JSON_OBJECT_MODE_desc: Ask the model for a JSON object; some gateways reject this parameter
field_AI_JSON_OBJECT_MODE_tip: Adds response_format=json_object, which makes structured output (lesson plans, question generation) far more reliable. Some third-party gateways and self-hosted proxies reject the parameter outright; the call is retried once without it on failure. Default off.
field_AI_STRICT_PARSE_desc: Accept only complete, valid results; truncated or incomplete output counts as failure
field_AI_STRICT_PARSE_tip: When off, truncated JSON is salvaged and accepted: generation succeeds more often but may include incomplete questions or empty fields. Turn it off temporarily only when batch generation keeps failing and someone can review the output. Default on.
field_IMAGE_EXTRACT_MAX_TOKENS_desc: Max tokens per image question extraction; raise it for long or multiple images — higher values mean longer waits and higher cost
field_CAST_TTS_CONCURRENCY_desc: Number of speech segments synthesised at once; tune to your account rate limit
field_CAST_TTS_CONCURRENCY_tip: Higher values shorten long casts but can trip the account QPS limit and leave failed segments. Use 3-4 for new accounts or when several people cast at once. Allowed 1-12.
placeholder_tagsSelect: Type and press Enter, or pick a suggestion
placeholder_endpoint: Pick an official endpoint, or enter your gateway URL
errDurationRange: Only whole minutes between {{min}} and {{max}}; invalid entries ignored
notifNoCaller: No caller in this version; leaving it off is fine
shapeAssertFailed: These settings have an invalid format, save blocked: {{items}}
shapeExpectNumber: expected a number or switch value
userMgmtIntro: Find anyone from one ledger: search, or filter by grade, class and role. Click a row to view details, reset the password or delete the account.
profileBlankHint: Cleared fields are saved as empty
deleteAccountWarn: Scores and roll-call records tied to this account are removed too. This cannot be undone.
roleChangeHint: Admins only. Turning a teacher into a student clears their teaching assignments.
roleChangeDesc: Change {{name}} to {{role}}. Teaching assignments are cleared when a teacher becomes a student.
importCsvHint: Bulk import from CSV; see the template for columns. Row-level errors are listed while importing.
taskPageSubtitle: Assign, submit and grade in one pipeline
announcementsSubtitle: Publish notices, pin what matters, see who read them
notificationsSubtitle: System notices and pushes, filter by type and bulk-handle
systemConfigSubtitle: API keys, models, storage and runtime options
downloadsSubtitle: Files shared by teachers, in one place
passwordSubtitle: Rotate your password regularly for safety
field_EXPLORE_CANVAS_ENABLED_desc: Off hides the entry and returns 404 for all endpoints; existing canvases stay untouched
field_EXPLORE_CHAT_QUOTA_desc: Daily cap of canvas Q&A (incl. image follow-ups); 0 disables; admins are unlimited
field_EXPLORE_IMAGE_QUOTA_desc: Only photo-style Wanxiang images count here; SVG diagrams are free and unlimited; admins are unlimited
field_EXPLORE_TTS_QUOTA_desc: Per-day card narration limit; cached texts still count; admins are unlimited
field_EXPLORE_CONTINUOUS_REMIND_MIN_desc: Gentle break prompt only, never forces exit
field_EXPLORE_ASR_ENABLED_desc: Server channel behind the canvas "dictate" button: Chrome/Edge already do this in-browser; this is the fallback for Firefox and other browsers without Web Speech. Metered by the minute, small cost
field_EXPLORE_SWEEP_DRY_desc: Off (default): real cleanup runs daily — orphan assets move to trash and are deleted only after the retention period. On: this run only writes a manifest, no files touched
field_EXPLORE_SWEEP_DRY_tip: There is no manual trigger; cleanup runs as a daily job (see Sweep hour). Turn this on for a day to preview what a run would process. Manifests are browsable in System config → Explore canvas → Asset storage, stored under question_media/explore_canvas_trash/manifest_YYYYMMDD.json.
field_EXPLORE_LOG_RAW_PROMPT: Log raw questions in task ledger (debug)
field_EXPLORE_LOG_RAW_PROMPT_desc: Off (recommended): the ledger stores only an irreversible hash, keeping the “count behavior, never content” promise. On: first 200 chars are written to pc_ai_tasks
field_EXPLORE_LOG_RAW_PROMPT_tip: Turn on only while diagnosing a bad model answer, and switch it back off afterwards. While on, students' question text is retained in the database — a privacy policy change worth telling teachers about first.
field_EXPLORE_ASSET_ORPHAN_DAYS_desc: Unreferenced assets older than this move to trash
field_EXPLORE_ASSET_TRASH_DAYS_desc: Hard delete only after this; restorable within
field_EXPLORE_TMP_HOURS_desc: ASR recordings etc. cleaned after this if unreferenced
field_EXPLORE_ASSET_MAX_MB_desc: Over watermark only warns; in-use student works are never force-deleted
field_EXPLORE_SWEEP_HOUR_desc: Runs off-peak, plus one light pass 60s after start
field_EXPLORE_ASR_MINUTES_desc: Per-user daily cap for server-side speech recognition (approximate); admins unlimited
field_EXPLORE_ASR_MODEL_desc: Audio sent inline (base64) via the OpenAI-compatible endpoint; default qwen3-asr-flash. Click Self-check to verify key / endpoint / model name
field_EXPLORE_ASR_MODEL_tip: Self-check probes with a 1-second silent sample and costs no recognition quota: HTTP 200 with a parsable body means the chain works; real accuracy is judged by actual dictation. Type the full model name when switching (suggestion list optional); takes effect immediately after save.
asrCheckReqFail: Request failed; check network or login state
field_EXPLORE_CANVAS_TRASH_DAYS_desc: Archived canvases older than this are destroyed with their pages; restorable within
field_EXPLORE_TTS_CACHE_MB_desc: When the speech cache exceeds this size the sweeper drops least-recently-used files; classroom outputs from the last 7 days are exempt and cache is regenerable
field_EXPLORE_PAGE_TRASH_DAYS_desc: How long deleted pages stay restorable; after that the page and its timeline snapshots are destroyed
field_EXPLORE_SHARE_EXPIRE_DAYS_desc: Read-only snapshots shared to teachers are auto-recycled after expiry
field_EXPLORE_CANVAS_MAX_desc: Max active (non-archived) canvases per user; 0 = unlimited. Prevents runaway growth
field_MODEL_IMAGE_VIA_CHAT: Prefer the chat model for image understanding
field_MODEL_IMAGE_VIA_CHAT_desc: Whiteboard / canvas / chat image questions go to the chat model (faster and cheaper); solving tasks still use the vision model. Turn off to send everything to the vision model
field_MODEL_IMAGE_VIA_CHAT_tip: Whether the chat model accepts images is detected automatically: on HTTP 400/415/422 the request falls back to the vision model and the model is skipped for an hour. After changing models it is retried automatically. Turning both switches off restores the old all-vision behaviour.
field_MODEL_IMAGE_SOLVE_VL: Use the vision model for solving tasks
field_MODEL_IMAGE_SOLVE_VL_desc: When the question or circled content looks like a solving task (prove, calculate, options, formulas), the vision model answers instead — it reads handwriting and formulas more reliably
field_CHAT_ASSET_QUOTA_MB_desc: Per-user cap for chat attachments (0 = unlimited). Attachments live as long as the conversation history; deleting a chat frees space only after the cleanup job runs
field_CHAT_ASSET_GC_DAYS_desc: Delete attachments that no longer appear in any saved conversation and have been idle for this many days (0 = never)
field_EXAM_WA_MAX_QUESTIONS_desc: How many highest-error questions one class review covers (1-30, default 8) — bounds wait time and token cost
field_EXAM_WA_RATE_CEILING_desc: Only questions with accuracy below this enter the review (10-100, default 90); lower = only the worst, higher = wider coverage
field_EXAM_ANTI_COPY_desc: On exam / practice / quiz answer pages, block selecting, copying, right-click and print shortcuts; answer inputs stay unaffected
field_EXAM_ANTI_COPY_tip: Raises the cost of lifting questions but cannot stop OS screenshots, phone photos or DevTools. Answering and pasting answers keep working. Off by default — enable only for formal exams.
field_EXAM_WATERMARK_desc: Tiles a faint “name · student ID · time” watermark so leaked screenshots can be traced
field_EXAM_WATERMARK_tip: The overlay never blocks clicks or scrolling and appears in print. It contains personal data — use it only for leak tracing and tell students.
field_news_rss_feeds_desc: What you see is what gets fetched — this list is exactly what the next fetch uses. Delete a row to disable a feed, edit the URL to replace it. An empty list does NOT mean no feeds: it falls back to built-in defaults (safety net against accidental wipes).
field_news_rss_feeds_tip:
Built-ins: Chinanews ×2 / IT之家 / SSPai. Auto-promoted reserve feeds appear here; delete a promoted row and save to demote it back.
Saving makes this list explicit — no redeploy or restart needed.
Before swapping feeds, click Auto-discover feeds below, or validate with: python scripts/check_news_feeds.py --url <RSS>. A feed failing 2 rounds in a row is circuit-broken for 30 minutes and admins are notified.
field_news_rss_reserves_desc: One feed per row; idle normally, auto-rescues when all main feeds fail, and auto-probes candidates if the reserve pool fails too. Empty = built-in reserve (Solidot) only
field_news_rss_reserves_tip:
A reserve feed rescuing 2 consecutive rounds with pubDate is auto-promoted into the main list; a promoted feed broken for 24h+ is auto-demoted.
When both main and reserve feeds fail, the fetch pipeline auto-probes the candidate list (max once per 6h) and appends working feeds here — no manual step needed; the Auto-discover feeds button triggers the same probe on demand.
Breakers / outage / auto-discovery / promote / demote all send admin notifications.
placeholder_news_rss: Name=https://example.com/rss.xml (one per line; delete a line to disable)
shapeExpectKv: Each line must look like Name=https://… (delete a line to disable; an empty list falls back to built-ins, never zero feeds)
newsDiscoverAdded: Added {n} verified feeds to the reserve pool: {names}
newsDiscoverNoAdd: Found {n} working feeds — all already listed
newsDiscoverNone: Probed {probed} candidates; no new working feeds found
